_source: New India Assurance — Q1 FY2026-27 Commission & Incentive circular (Agents/POSP and Brokers/Web-Aggregator cards carry identical motor OD%/TP% tables).
_model: Commission is TWO legs: an OD% applied to the OD premium + a TP% applied to the TP premium. Headline rate (what the operator reports) = OD + TP, EXCEPT when the two legs are equal it is reported as the single value. Stand-Alone TP = TP leg only; Stand-Alone OD = OD leg only. Edit the numbers below when the circular is revised — no code change needed.
_od_leg_note: "od_leg" as an od value means: use the state-resolved OD leg (od_leg_uplift for cars registered in od_uplift_states, else od_leg_base).

car._uplift_note: MH/KA OD-leg uplift REVERTED to circular base 2026-07-01 (user): od_uplift_states emptied so every state uses od_leg_base=20 (was 30 for MH/KA, an operator-derived uplift not in the circular). To re-enable, add state prefixes back to od_uplift_states.

new_vehicle._note: age 0 — bundled 1+3; OD fixed 25 (no state uplift)

gcv._bands: First band whose min_tonnage is strictly below the vehicle tonnage wins (GVW in tonnes). new = age 0, old = age > 0.

other._note: Other commercial vehicles (excl GCV / school bus / electric bus)
